Studio.title: Studio
Studio.description: A production house or studio client for whom the cinematographer shoots events.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase user UID who owns this studio record.

name.description: Display name of the studio or production company.

contactPerson.description: Optional producer or studio contact person details.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the studio was created (must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the studio was last updated (must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

ShootRecord.title: ShootRecord
ShootRecord.description: An event shoot project completed by the cinematographer with confirmed earnings.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase user UID who owns this shoot record.

title.description: Title of the event or shoot project.

studioId.description: ID of the studio associated with this shoot.

studioName.description: Denormalized name of the studio for display.

shootDateMillis.description: Epoch milliseconds of the shoot date.

location.description: Venue or city where the shoot took place.

durationValue.description: Number of days or hours spent on the shoot.

earnings.description: Confirmed total earnings for this shoot project.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the shoot was logged (must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the shoot was last updated (must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

WithdrawalRecord.title: WithdrawalRecord
WithdrawalRecord.description: A payout withdrawal received by the cinematographer from a studio.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase user UID who owns this withdrawal record.

studioId.description: ID of the studio from which the withdrawal was received.

amount.description: Amount withdrawn or collected from the studio.

withdrawalDateMillis.description: Epoch milliseconds when the withdrawal occurred.

paymentMethod.description: Method of payment for the studio withdrawal.

notes.description: Optional payment reference or settlement notes.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the withdrawal was recorded (must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the withdrawal was last updated (must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/studios/{studioId}.description: Per-user subcollection of studios and production houses.

/users/{userId}/shoots/{shootId}.description: Per-user subcollection of completed event shoots and project earnings.

/users/{userId}/withdrawals/{withdrawalI.description: Per-user subcollection of studio withdrawals and settlement transactions.
